description: Timer closure reads its own env var and execs it; the wrapper's parameter is only logged. The closure's own env -> exec flow is reported, but the request value passed to schedule() must not be attributed to the exec.

expected.notes: process.env.CRON_CMD flows to cp.exec inside the timer closure
schedule(req.query.name): the label never reaches the closure's exec, so the closure's own flow is not a flow from this argument
